Claire — attaching our redline of the standard Redwood DPA focused on the items you flagged. Key points:

- We accept SCCs for EU data transfers; we add subprocessors list via our subprocessor registry and commit to notification within 30 days of changes (we can discuss exceptions).
- Retention: proposed 30 days for non-identifying logs; event logs 12 months unless contract specifies otherwise.
- We removed the strike-through on sections that would force on-prem storage; our architecture supports region pinning but not guaranteed physical segregation beyond region isolation.

I've flagged two negotiation items for exec approval: indemnity cap carveout and audit frequency.

Please find the redline attached. If FinPay can review and return a counter by EOD Thu we can route for signature early next week.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
